purpose: Qualify a geography-matched same-order versus different-order paired transfer contrast after development-stage evidence that the v0.1 same-order-versus-all-geographic baseline dilutes the lineage-composition signal.

estimator_change.rationale: The v0.1 reference pool contains same-order sources and therefore partially contains the condition being tested. v0.2 uses disjoint source-lineage pools under the identical geographic support rule.

frozen_estimator.estimand: species-equal mean of [C_same_order_geo - C_different_order_geo] over evaluation species supported by both disjoint source pools
frozen_estimator.source_mass_normalization: multiply each target-specific pool's edge weights by N_train/N_selected so both fields preserve the full training panel's total pre-kernel species-weight mass
frozen_estimator.inference: one-sided centered studentized held-out-species bootstrap of paired target increments

development_pilot_disclosure.note: Local development pilots used the older conditional-order seed namespace to compare reference-pool definitions. Those worlds are excluded from v0.2 formal qualification by new seed tags.
development_pilot_disclosure.interpretation: Pilot counts motivated freezing a clean contrast; they are not used to claim Type-I control or power.

positive_control.group_rule: exact frozen phylogatR order shared within order, independent across orders

qualification.type1_gate: for every private-null cell, Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate must be <=0.10
qualification.power_gate: same_order_A2 Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate must be >=0.80
qualification.overall_pass: all four private Type-I cells pass AND same_order_A2 power passes
qualification.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITIONAL_ORDER_CONTRAST_V02; do not open confirmatory nucleotide identity

confirmatory_sequence: formal v0.2 synthetic qualification on development geometry must PASS
confirmatory character-mask admissibility under frozen sequence rules
rebuild exact survivor geometry without changing source-pool rules
repeat exact-geometry v0.2 synthetic qualification on survivor geometry
only then authorize one confirmatory nucleotide-identity opening
forbidden_after_freeze: changing same-versus-different contrast after formal qualification is seen
changing support radius, 50 percent coverage threshold, or five-source minima
reusing development-pilot seed tags as formal qualification worlds
dropping difficult supported targets based on synthetic or empirical increments
opening confirmatory nucleotide identity before all qualification and admissibility gates pass

execution.sharding_semantics: absolute replicate index only; internal batch partition must not alter world or bootstrap identity
execution.formal_cell_output: one complete 500-replicate shard per frozen qualification cell
